what: A tool that converts X-CLIP model checkpoints could run code hidden in a checkpoint file.
tarjim: tarjim never converts checkpoints and never loads X-CLIP models.
fix: transformers 5.0.0. tarjim installs it once qwen-asr, its listening engine, allows transformers 5 (qwen-asr 0.0.6 requires 4.57.6 exactly, and stops loading with any 5.x release).

what: Resuming a training run from a crafted checkpoint could run code, when PyTorch is older than 2.6.
tarjim: tarjim never trains models, so it never resumes from a checkpoint.
fix: transformers 5.0.0. tarjim installs it once qwen-asr, its listening engine, allows transformers 5 (qwen-asr 0.0.6 requires 4.57.6 exactly, and stops loading with any 5.x release).

what: A model whose config.json was written by an attacker could make transformers fetch and run code from another repository.
tarjim: tarjim loads only its own models, each from one fixed commit it checked, from a folder on this computer and offline, so a changed config.json never reaches it; the kernels package this needs is not installed either.
fix: transformers 5.3.0. tarjim installs it once qwen-asr, its listening engine, allows transformers 5 (qwen-asr 0.0.6 requires 4.57.6 exactly, and stops loading with any 5.x release).

what: Loading a LightGlue model from an attacker's repository could run its code even with remote code switched off.
tarjim: tarjim never loads LightGlue models; its own models come from fixed commits it checked.
fix: transformers 5.5.0. tarjim installs it once qwen-asr, its listening engine, allows transformers 5 (qwen-asr 0.0.6 requires 4.57.6 exactly, and stops loading with any 5.x release).

what: Saving a tokenizer that came from a crafted repository could write files outside the chosen folder.
tarjim: tarjim never saves a tokenizer or processor that way (save_pretrained), and its models come from fixed commits it checked.
fix: transformers 5.10.0. tarjim installs it once qwen-asr, its listening engine, allows transformers 5 (qwen-asr 0.0.6 requires 4.57.6 exactly, and stops loading with any 5.x release).

what: Loading a model from a repository that carries custom generation code saves that code to disk before asking for permission; it is not run.
tarjim: tarjim downloads only the model files it needs, never code, from fixed commits it checked, and loads them from a folder on this computer, so no such code is fetched.
fix: transformers 5.9.0. tarjim installs it once qwen-asr, its listening engine, allows transformers 5 (qwen-asr 0.0.6 requires 4.57.6 exactly, and stops loading with any 5.x release).
